- **`/courses/{id}`** — Course detail with description, schedule, credits, location, enrollment status, and full instructor bio
- **`/enroll`** — Standard HTML form for enrollment requests (name, student ID, course selection, optional comments) with confirmation number on submit

**Architecture:**
- `Models/` — `Department`, `Course`, `Instructor`, `EnrollmentRequest` (with validation attributes)
- `Services/` — `CatalogService` (in-memory seed data with 6 departments, 8 instructors, 15 courses) and `EnrollmentService`
- No authentication, no JavaScript interactivity needed — pure server-rendered forms

Run with: `cd UniversityCourseCatalog && dotnet run`
